overview: A Lower Jurassic ichthyosaur genus represented in this profile by diagnosable Hettangian Somerset specimens rather than an undifferentiated global occurrence set.

ecology.diet: Probable fish remains in one I. communis individual's gullet contents
ecology.habitat: Marine; habitat breadth is not resolved by the cited specimens
ecology.locomotion: Caudal-fluke propulsion inferred from comparative vertebral anatomy
ecology.bodySize: A genus-wide body-size envelope is not inferred from the cited specimens
ecology.guild: Predatory ecology documented for one I. communis individual

evidenceSummary: Primary species descriptions support diagnosis and a regional Hettangian sample; the broader global range and detailed performance remain provisional composites or inferences.

overview: A marine sauropterygian radiation with a diagnostic Rhaetian record; older Bobosaurus is displayed as an uncertain candidate and does not set the Plesiosauria range.
traits: Neck and skull proportions vary widely
evidenceSummary: Rhaeticosaurus provides articulated diagnostic anatomy and histology; Bobosaurus is older but phylogenetically less secure, and hydrodynamic performance remains model-based.

geography: Every continent; fossil record extremely patchy
overview: An archosaur flying-reptile radiation usually placed within Ornithodira near dinosaurs, while its precise origin remains analysis-dependent; package evidence spans eggs, soft tissues and bounded launch models.
traits: Membranous wing supported mainly by digit IV
Quadrupedal launch is a tested biomechanical model
evidenceSummary: Named fossils directly document eggs and integument; flight and launch performance derive from explicit models and are not generalized across every pterosaur.

title.zh: 主龙类中接近恐龙的一支

text.en: Expanded anatomical analyses place pterosaurs within Ornithodira, on the archosaur branch close to dinosaurs. Their exact origin and closest relatives remain dependent on the characters and analyses used; this placement does not identify a direct dinosaur ancestor.
text.zh: 扩展解剖特征的系统分析将翼龙置于鸟跖类，属于接近恐龙的主龙类支系。但其确切起源和最近亲仍随所选特征与分析方法而变化；这种位置判断并未指出某个恐龙是翼龙的直接祖先。

title.en: A worldwide record with large gaps
title.zh: 全球都有记录，但缺口很大

text.en: The redescription of Carniadactylus documents a Norian pterosaur sample from the Late Triassic, but one dated locality does not establish the group’s first global appearance. A separate analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa reported remains from every continent while emphasizing severe gaps in where and when fossils are known. Geographic patterns therefore depend on an uneven, time-sensitive record.
text.zh: Carniadactylus 的重新描述记录了晚三叠世诺利期的翼龙材料，但一个有年代依据的地点不能确定翼龙类在全球的最早出现。另一项包含 108 个翼龙分类单元的分析报告称各大洲均有化石，同时强调已知记录在空间与时间上都有严重缺口。因此，地理格局解释受不均匀且随时间变化的化石记录影响。

title.zh: 特定化石究竟保存了什么

text.en: One Hamipterus block preserves many eggs, including embryo-bearing eggs, giving a direct fossil record of reproduction in that deposit. In a separate Crato Formation specimen, melanosome geometry in preserved integument was used to assess a possible signalling role. These are specific fossil cases; behavioral readings and feather-homology claims remain interpretations, not observations of living pterosaurs.
text.zh: 一块 Hamipterus 化石板保存了多枚卵，其中有些含胚胎，为该沉积地点提供了直接的翼龙繁殖化石记录。另一件来自 Crato 组的标本，其保存体表组织中的黑素体形态被用于评估可能的信号展示功能。这些结论属于特定化石案例；行为解释和“羽毛”同源判断仍是研究者的解释，不是对活体翼龙的直接观察。

title.zh: 用明确假设检验飞行能力

text.en: Biomechanical studies use reconstructed body mass, wing dimensions, muscle power and launch kinematics to test whether giant pterosaurs could fly and launch quadrupedally. Their outputs are feasibility results conditioned on those inputs, not preserved motions or measurements that apply uniformly across the pterosaur radiation.
text.zh: 生物力学研究以重建的体重、翼部尺寸、肌肉功率和起飞运动学为输入，检验巨型翼龙能否飞行及以四足方式起飞。其结论是在这些输入条件下得到的可行性结果，不是保存下来的动作，也不能一概推广到所有翼龙类群。

scope.en: Systematic review and expanded anatomical phylogenetic analyses; supports an ornithodiran placement while retaining uncertainty over pterosaur origins and closest relatives.
scope.zh: 系统综述与扩展解剖系统分析支持将翼龙置于鸟跖类，同时保留其起源和最近亲的不确定性。

title.en: Dalla Vecchia (2009), Carniadactylus anatomy and systematics
title.zh: Dalla Vecchia（2009），Carniadactylus 的解剖与系统分类

scope.en: Detailed redescription and phylogenetic analysis of Norian pterosaur holotype MFSN 1797 and referred specimen MPUM 6009; this locality does not establish a global first appearance.
scope.zh: 对诺利期翼龙正模 MFSN 1797 与归入标本 MPUM 6009 的详细再描述和系统分析；该地点不能确定全球最早出现时间。

title.zh: Upchurch 等（2015），翼龙地理分布分析

scope.en: Quantitative analysis of 108 pterosaur taxa; reports an every-continent record while emphasizing severe spatial and temporal patchiness and sampling-sensitive biogeographic inference.
scope.zh: 对 108 个翼龙分类单元进行定量分析；报告各大洲均有记录，同时指出时空分布极不均匀，地理推断受采样影响。

title.en: Wang et al. (2017), Hamipterus eggs and embryos
title.zh: Wang 等（2017），Hamipterus 的卵与胚胎

scope.en: Reports exposed Hamipterus eggs and embryo-bearing specimens from one fossil block; behavioral and hatchling-flight interpretations remain distinct from preserved evidence.
scope.zh: 报告一块化石板上的 Hamipterus 卵及含胚胎标本；行为和幼体飞行解释须与直接保存的证据区分。

title.en: Cincotta et al. (2022), pterosaur melanosomes and signalling
title.zh: Cincotta 等（2022），翼龙黑素体与信号展示

scope.en: Analyzes preserved integument and melanosome geometry in a Crato Formation pterosaur specimen; signalling function and exact colour are interpretive conclusions.
scope.zh: 分析 Crato 组一件翼龙标本保存的体表组织与黑素体形态；信号展示功能与确切颜色均属解释性结论。

title.en: Witton and Habib (2010), giant pterosaur flight models
title.zh: Witton 与 Habib（2010），巨型翼龙飞行模型

scope.en: Comparative scaling and biomechanical feasibility study; reconstructed mass, wing planform, muscle power and launch kinematics are model inputs, not direct observations.
scope.zh: 比较尺度与生物力学可行性研究；重建体重、翼面积、肌肉功率和起飞运动学均为模型输入，并非直接观察。

readerLimitations.en: This is a selective route through studies of relationships, fossils, geography and biomechanics. The fossil record is patchy; the cited locality and specimen results do not establish a complete global range, life history, diet or uniform flight capability. The profile is not externally expert-reviewed.
readerLimitations.zh: 本页精选了亲缘关系、化石、地理分布和生物力学研究作为阅读路径。翼龙化石记录存在明显缺口；所引地点与标本结果不能构成完整全球分布、生活史、食性或适用于所有翼龙的飞行能力总结。本文尚未经过领域专家外审。

geography: South Majiashan Quarry, Chaohu, Anhui, China
overview: An Early Triassic ichthyosauromorph genus represented by maternal specimen AGM I-1; delayed ossification, dental morphology, vertebral count and hypophalangeal flippers support the assignment, while species-level taxonomy remains revisable.

ecology.diet: Diet is not directly preserved by maternal specimen AGM I-1 and remains unresolved
ecology.habitat: Marine ichthyosauromorph from the Majiashan depositional setting; habitual habitat is not directly resolved
ecology.locomotion: Paddle-like flippers are preserved, but gait and swimming performance were not measured
ecology.bodySize: AGM I-1 records an adult with embryos; a genus-wide body-size envelope is not inferred
ecology.guild: Predatory guild is not directly observed in the maternal specimen

traits: Maternal skeleton with two embryos and an adjacent neonate
Delayed ossification of carpals and tarsals relative to metacarpals, metatarsals and phalanges
Hypophalangeal flippers and the dental and vertebral characters used for genus assignment
evidenceSummary: Primary study Motani et al. documents AGM I-1 from south Majiashan Quarry in the Spathian Nanlinghu Formation and records two embryos plus a neonate. Embryo orientation and a terrestrial origin of viviparity are comparative interpretations, not directly observed behaviour or an ancestral state for all ichthyosaurs.

geography: Clay pit #3 of Lücking brick company, 1 km north of Bonenburg, Warburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
Rhaetian dark marine mudstones of the Exter Formation
overview: A small-bodied Late Triassic plesiosaurian represented by holotype LWL-MFN P 64047; its articulated anatomy and phylogenetic analysis extend the sampled plesiosaurian record into the Rhaetian without making the specimen a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Diet and prey are not directly preserved by the partial holotype
ecology.habitat: Marine mudstone depositional setting in the Rhaetian Exter Formation; habitual microhabitat remains unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Four similar flippers and a short tail support plesiosaurian hydrofoil and paraxial-locomotion comparisons, not a measured gait
ecology.bodySize: The subadult holotype has an estimated total length of 237 cm; a genus-wide size range is not inferred
ecology.guild: Marine predatory ecology is a broad plesiosaurian interpretation, not a directly observed feeding record

traits: Partial articulated skeleton preserving occiput, lower jaw, vertebral column, girdles and left limbs
Ventrally concave V-shaped neurocentral sutures in anterior and middle cervical vertebrae
Foreshortened zeugopodials and highly vascularized humeral and femoral bone tissue
evidenceSummary: Wintrich et al. describe holotype LWL-MFN P 64047 from a defined bed in the Exter Formation at Bonenburg, 21 m below the Triassic–Jurassic boundary. Figures and supplementary sections document the skeleton and histology; basal pliosaurid placement, fast growth and physiological implications remain topology- and interpretation-dependent.
